author: Zephyr I
title: NodIl bottleneck ratio fine ablation (std-width d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM)
abstract: Fine-tune bottleneck mid-channel ratio for the nodil-bottleneck SOTA-competitive config. Test ratio ∈ {0.20, 0.25, 0.30} with 32/64 CNN, main-conv dilation d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; no FE. BASE_SEED=42.
